summary.name: Textero
summary.one_liner: Textero is a web-based AI essay writer that generates structured academic essays with citations from uploaded instructions and sources, along with related writing tools.
use_cases: Drafting an essay from a topic and assignment instructions
Generating a starting draft instead of a blank page
Formatting citations in MLA, APA, or Chicago style
Checking AI score or plagiarism of an essay
Creating an outline to structure a paper
summary.what_it_does: Textero generates essays of several types, including argumentative, analytical, expository, narrative, and research-based papers. Users enter a topic, essay type, and optional uploaded files such as professor guidelines or reading materials, and the tool produces a draft. The page says it includes a built-in AI citing assistant for MLA, APA, Chicago and other formats, and that it uses scholarly sources. Each request allows up to 3,000 words per session. The draft can be edited, checked with an AI detector and plagiarism checker, and exported via a Google Doc. The site also lists free companion tools: AI fixer, paraphraser, summarizer, essay rewriter, PDF summarizer, and outline generator.
notable: Built-in AI citing assistant for MLA, APA, Chicago formats
Accepts uploaded instructions, rubrics, and reading materials
caveats: Each request is limited to 3,000 words per session
Page says the free AI detector is free, but the essay generator's full pricing is not stated
Page is largely marketing testimonials; claims about source quality and originality are not independently verified
